big_case.notes: A single statutory question (12 U.S.C. 248a(c)(2) vs. 342) with real consequences for crypto/fintech banks' access to Federal Reserve master accounts and for state chartering power; three cert-stage amicus briefs including sitting and former Senators, a dissent below and a 3-vote en banc minority. But no circuit split, the constitutional overlay was held waived, and the Court denied at the first conference with no relist and no noted dissent. Sector-important, not a landmark.
